crossRefs.note: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.
Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…
Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

translations.web: The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
translations.bsb: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon,
translations.kjv: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
translations.asv: And the tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
